title: Export selected scoped loading-list evidence page to Excel
description: Users download selected columns in request order and the current evidence page as Excel through a dedicated export endpoint rebuilding fresh bounded authorized evidence; never trust client rows or a preview cache. Reuse finite DTO/rules/source and existing NPOI with narrow DynamicContainerStatsExcelExporter, direct controller construction, no DI/package/config change. Numeric signed recorded cartons/kg/m3 and scoped counts retain numeric cells; nullable utilization shows unknown, never zero/68m3-derived percentage; type unknown/source reasons are explicit. Always include normalized dates/filters/current-page coverage/source count and cap/scoped customer and grouping identity/recorded units/unknown capacity-type-shipping evidence even selected fields omit them. No all-match/cross-unit total, physical-container-count claim or appended unselected detail columns. Formula-like raw container strings/context are literal text cells, not formulas. Existing UI downloads with current field/filter/page state and preserves it while reporting fresh-permission/source-cap/export failure without stale download. Existing HTTP audit only, no duplicate business records. Development only. Reuse existing container-stats menu, current-user SalespersonDataScopeService customer scope, approved nondeleted ContainerLoadingLists and OperationLogMiddleware HTTP audit. Each endpoint revalidates current input and rechecks identity/menu/fresh scope; revoked permission, invalid input and source overflow return no data/file. Date span <=366 inclusive days, whole end day via next-day exclusive boundary with overflow rejection, stable source probe Take(501) and fail closed above 500 authorized matching list headers. Recorded cartons/kg/m3 are scoped list-header evidence, not verified stock-out, actual shipping, revenue or physical container totals. Partial customer scope must never reveal excluded customers/records or infer whole-container utilization, type, capacity or shipping state. No client identity/scope/rows/aggregates as authority, arbitrary/model-generated SQL, business writes, new domain entities or persistence schema, migrations, schema/view/stored-procedure changes, production SQL or real database execution, credentials/secrets/.env/config changes, irreversible operations, production deployment or real browser acceptance. Preserve unrelated modules and uncommitted work. Run focused in-memory service/API/export/UI source-contract tests plus configured safe Release build/test; unavailable external database/browser acceptance is environment-blocked, never fabricated passed.
acceptance_criteria: Excel endpoint revalidates fields/filters/page and fresh identity/menu/customer scope, rebuilding the same authorized capped current page without client rows or cached previews.
Workbook preserves selected order, separate numeric signed unit measures/counts, explicit unknown utilization/type and mandatory context with formula-safe strings and no unsupported totals.

Existing page Excel download retains request state and handles failures; workbook/controller/UI tests cover revoked scope, caps, empty pages, negative/zero measures, unknowns and formula strings; safe build/test passes.
